title: Review of today's 44 tasks: what's really done

chat.text: Four read-only reviewers checked every task from 2026-10-03 against your words, its proof, and the code. Most landed work is real but thinly proven; one feature (live prompt refinement) is not done though it reads as landed; finished work sits unmerged on branches; and the review gate passes some changes without looking at them.

add.title: The five things that matter
add.text:
1. **Live prompt refinement is not done.** #prompts-live landed only an Echo bug fix; the refiner still doesn't run end to end, so #topic-cards' 'built from refined prompts' is undelivered too.
2. **The review gate passes work it never saw.** When a task's work is committed straight to the main tree, `Server/review.mjs` sees an empty diff and writes 'No review needed: only CSS/docs changed' — 8 of today's reviews say that, including ones that changed core JS (move-nesting-fix, now-card-blank, prompts-live). Verified in code: `sizeOf()` returns 'none' for an empty diff.
3. **Finished work sits unmerged.** sessions-tab-polish, data-grid and framework-home-grids are built on branches; System has four competing worktree copies and nothing on dev.
4. **Servex restarts kill working agents** — the main cause of the two budget overruns. spend-gate even plans another restart. restart-keeps-agents must land first.
5. **Overlapping briefs.** dev-shell-polish and point-at-it would each build their own pointer overlay; the six Servex briefs all touch Agents.js; openrouter-reads-cache duplicates spend-gate.

add.title: Landed (24): verdicts
add.text:
**Done:** drawer-cleanup, field-collision-throw, ref-row-context-card.
**Not done:** prompts-live (see above).
**Done with gaps:**
- layout-gate — the new check can't see Doc pages (tabs + doc title), which is the page type you reported.
- layout-approve-join — the approved list isn't wired into reviews, though the landing ticks it.
- push-to-talk — off by default; the double send wasn't re-measured after b1ca77b9; modifier keys can stick; the screenshots don't show the mic.
- drop-at-key — big core change, no migration for old `at` lines.
- mention-auto-sync — syncs icons, not titles.
- session-trace — Claude-only cost, manual trace.json, checked at 1920 only.
- sessions-date-homes — item 2 is only a seam.
- playwright-reap — its reaper marker could hit the shared headed browser; it added a Playwright entry to ~/.claude.json (now denied anyway).
- flash-fix, ghost-theme-fix, move-nesting-fix, now-card-blank — fixes look right, proof is thin (final-state shot, probe page, or no review).
- card-measure-colors, inbox-cards-work, console-clean, page-ai-cost, page-no-log, ref-content-rows, subcard-columns, topic-cards — mostly real; small items left.

add.title: Open and queued: the order I'm taking
add.text:
1. **Land, then stop spending:** sessions-tab-polish, then data-grid (auto-filters and 'list other tables' move to a small follow-up). Both edit ai/sessions/page.js, so in that order.
2. **System:** land the cleanest worktree copy (System.js, demo, doc), defer the AI-page conversion, delete the other three copies.
3. **Servex, for @mastermind-servex-10:** split restart-keeps-agents and land the restart fix first; then spend-gate steps 1–4 (OpenRouter probe folded in); pool-unstick with a dry run; node-reap-run only after the branches land; main-branch-guard gets its task line; perf-audit cut to three paths. Plus: fix the empty-diff review pass.
4. **Briefs to rewrite before they run:** dev-shell-polish + point-at-it (split, one shared overlay, Ctrl+Shift+click first); ai-git-context-cost (restore 'separate commit, reversible' and 'masterminds log improvements'). **Run as-is:** launch-icons, machine-page (extend ui/badge), tab-memory (longer soak first). **Drop as a brief:** readme-weight; its 282 broken links go to the docs agent.
5. **Ask you, only if it matters:** framework-home-grids — you stopped it at 18:37 and the reason isn't recorded. I'll look at it at 3440 and land or drop it.
